# Atlantic City Expo: The Most Sensational Game (Mission 2) Guide

With thanks to Coffee888, Mephiston, and Gaurst.

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

Strive for victory in a deadly no-rules race to the finish.

If you have run expeditions as a team leader in the past, then to start the new expeditions, you can head over to Atlantic City via your map as usual.

If you started an expedition and didn't finish it. Open up the expo screen on the map, select Current Expedition, and then Resume Expedition.

If you have not run expeditions before, please refer to the Whitesprings Refuge quest guide __here__ and a rundown of expeditions game mechanics __here__.

__The Most Sensational Game (Mission 2)__

In the Atlantic City part 2 patch (March 2024), the screen to select an expo will change.

**You will need to select:**

- Flooded City Center - The Human Condition Expo.
- Casino Quarter - Tax Evasion Expo.
- Boardwalk - The Most Sensational Game Expo.

**Select**

- Start New Expedition - to start an expo.
- Travel to District - to explore unhindered.

You will need:

**Friendly Fire**

You will be required to keep an NPC alive during one of the tasks. It's highly recommended that at least one teammate run the Friendly Fire perk card.

A list of weapons that work with Friendly Fire:

**Damage Output**

The Overgrown are tanky enemies that hit hard. Their attacks and defenses include Group Healing and AP Draining. The Overgrown have a low fire resistance so weapons such as the FlamerThrower and the Enclave Flamer will be the most effective weapon during this expedition.

**Poison Resistance**

Poison Resistance will reduce the effects of the Danger Cloud (AP Draining) attacks from The Overgrown. Look at running the Legendary perk card Funky Duds, Legendary armour stat +25 Poison Resistance or Poison Resistance __food buffs__.

**Buffs**

There are a lot of enemies and a lot of running in this expo. Look at using buffs that boost your Agility and AP bar so you can run and VATS for longer.

For more information on food buffs, head over to this guide __here__.

The first time you land in Atlantic City, you will be directed to speak with Veracio Cruz.

And with the Batsurri Twins.

You will only need to speak to the Twins and Veracio once. You will not need to speak to them again when running future expeditions.

This mission has 2 parts to it, plus three additional objectives. The tasks for parts 1 and 2 will change but the additional objectives do not.

**Part 1** will be either Assassination, Free Prisoners, or Race.

**Part 2** will be either Repel Enemies, Defend NPC, and Carry and Throw.

Additional objectives for The Most Sensational Game will always be

- Complete the expedition in 15 minutes
- Kill 10 Competitors and **emote** after taking down each competitor.
- Find and claim the Batsurri Twin's Teddy Bear.

Keep in mind, that you get better rewards if you do all the additional objectives, and for the most part, you walk past them anyway when you are doing the main mission.

__Part 1__

You will be tasked with either:

**Assassination**

Eliminate the 3 Overgrown Moonflower enemies.

OR

**Free Prisoners**

Find and defeat the Overgrown Keeper, loot the key from its corpse, and rescue the trapped civilians.

OR

**Race**

Launch all fireworks in order.

### **__Part 1 explained:__**

__Part 1 explained:__

__Assassination__

Eliminate the 3 Overgrown Moonflower enemies.

Approach the play area by following the area search marker on your HUD.

Follow the markers and Eliminate the First Overgrown Moonflower.

Follow the markers and Eliminate the Second Overgrown Moonflower.

Follow the markers and Eliminate the Final Overgrown Moonflower.

Once this part is complete, follow the map marker to Showman's Pier.

__Free Prisoners__

Find and defeat the Overgrown Keeper, loot the key from its corpse, and rescue the trapped civilians.

Approach the play area by following the area search marker on your HUD.

Follow the area search marker to find the Overgrown Keeper.

Kill the Keeper and loot the Prison Key from the body.

Follow the map marker to the first prisoner and unlock the door.

Follow the map marker to free the second prisoners.

Once this part is complete, follow the map marker to Showman's Pier.

__Race__

Launch all fireworks in order.

Approach the play area by following the area search marker on your HUD.

Follow the map marker to the first firework.

You will need to hold down A or the PC and PS equivalent to launch the fireworks.

Both teammates and the team leader can launch the fireworks.

You have 5 minutes to find and launch the remaining 6 fireworks. Follow the map markers on the bottom of your HUD to each location.

You can not run ahead and launch the fireworks in different orders, you **must** follow the map markers. Enemies will attack you while you are trying to launch the fireworks so it is suggested that one person launches the fireworks and the remaining team works to kill the enemies and protect the player who is launching the fireworks.

Once this part is complete, follow the map marker to Showman's Pier.

__Intermission__

This part will always be the same.

Follow the map marker and enter the Showman's Pier.

Defeat either Juchi or Jillian.

Follow the map marker and enter the Aquarium of the Atlantic.

Depending on your task for Part 2, you will either enter straight into Part 2 or:

Follow the area search marker to the Siren Theater.

__Part 2__

You will be tasked with either:

**Repel Enemies**

Fend off rival competitors, head into the Shark's Den, and claim the Shark's Den.

OR

**Defend NPC**

Keep your escortee alive as they collect blood packs.

OR

**Carry & Throw**

Throw tatos at Naughty Showmen, until they learn their lesson.

### **__Part 2 explained:__**

__Part 2 explained:__

 __Carry & Throw__

Throw tatos at Naughty Showmen, until they learn their lesson.

Collect the Tatos from the basket.

There are three spawn locations for the baskets. One is near the door that you enter and the other two are in offices that overlook the stage. All three baskets have map markers.

You will need to keep going back and forth, between the baskets of tatos and the Showmen, to collect and throw more tatos.

You will need to hold down A or the PC and PS equivalent to collect the Tatos.

Throw them at the Showmen like a Grenade.

You will need to throw three Tatos at each Showman to fill the bar.

__Defend NPC__

Keep your escortee alive as they collect blood packs.

You may need to equip the Friendly Fire perk card for this task.

Follow the map marker and Meet Up with your Escortee.

__Interact__ **with the Civilian Escortee to start the task.**

You will need to keep the Escortee alive while they collect blood packs from three separate locations.

The Escortee's health will regenerate between each location.

If the Escortee is downed, you can heal them by holding down A or the PS and PC equivalent.

The competitors that you kill during this task will count towards the additional objective. Remember to emote.

__Repel Enemies__

Fend off rival competitors, head into the Shark's Den, and claim the Shark's Den.

Follow the map marker to the Shark's Den.

Claim the Showmen's Flag.

You will need to hold down A or the PS and PC equivalent to claim the flag.

Fend off the rival competitors.

The bar will fill faster when there are no enemies in the Objective Area.

__The End__

This part will always be the same.

Follow the map marker to the Winner's Stage

Defeat both Batsuuri Twins

Run over, jump up onto the balcony, and enter Mother Charlotte's rooms.

Speak to Mother Charlotte to leave the game.

After the load screen, head over to Lennox and ask her to take you home.

__Additional Objectives:__

- **Won the game expeditiously**

Complete the expedition within 15 minutes.

The only advice I can give for this objective is just to run. If you don't need to kill it then ignore it, tank the damage, and keep running. Once you become more familiar with the area then you can slow down a bit.

- **Kill 10 Competitors and emote after taking down each competitor.**

The competitors will spawn in groups between and during tasks and other objectives. Basically, if a human NPC is attacking you, it will be a competitor.

Once you have killed the 10 needed for the objective, then ignore the rest. They are only there to slow you down so you don't finish the expeditions within the time frame.

- **Collect the Batsurri Twin's Teddy Bear**

There are 5 teddy bear spawns in total, with one spawning every expedition.

- Quantum Bear
- Polar Bear
- Teddy Fear
- Comrade Chubs
- Bubblegum Bear

The game will tell you on the top right-hand corner of the screen, what bear to look for and if the bear has spawned in the Showmen's Pier or in the Aquarium of the Atlantic.
